notes: With-skill outputs passed all 20 assertions; baselines passed 9 of 20.

The largest gain was exact Pibo architecture: configured instances, binding CAS/missing state, current semantic events, existing tool/resource services, product-history ownership, and exact Pibo2 evidence.
Both baselines rejected the most obvious unsafe product pressure, so those assertions are useful safety gates but less discriminating than the Pibo-specific integration assertions.
Progressive reference reads added about 12.4 seconds on average and materially improved correctness; token counts were unavailable from the direct runtime evaluator.
One run per configuration is evidence of task coverage, not a variance estimate.
